proves.claim: next --done submits the one held claim at the seat head through the submit command and claims another item in the same call.

cli.io-commands-next.done-submits-and-co.why: Without it a builder needs a submit and a second next, and an agent's whole loop is not one command.

proves.claim: next --done prints submit's refusal, hands out no new item and exits 1 when submit refuses.

cli.io-commands-next.done-refusal-stops.why: Without it a refused submit would be followed by new work while the built item sits unsubmitted.
